merge.shape: One `"<english sentence>": "<chinese rendering>",` line per pair, inside `export const proseZh`.
merge.note: Every key below is exactly what `node apps/showcase/scripts/i18n-pending.mjs` reports for the three source files, so a straight insert takes the Showcase back to zero pending sentences. 'Data table' is not a mistake: it is the `title` of a resource card, and a `title` in a documentation data array is prose by this repository's own definition (`scripts/i18n-prose.mjs`).

sentences.en: Bilingual by default
sentences.zh: 默认双语

sentences.en: Every LUC interface
sentences.zh: 每一个 LUC 界面

sentences.en: starts from one system.
sentences.zh: 都始于同一套系统。

sentences.en: A React and TypeScript design system: three token layers, accessible components, spatial motion, data display and charts — documented one component at a time.
sentences.zh: 一套 React 与 TypeScript 设计系统：三层令牌、可访问的组件、空间动效、数据展示与图表——并且逐个组件地写成文档。

sentences.en: Browse the components
sentences.zh: 浏览组件

sentences.en: Explore the charts
sentences.zh: 探索图表

sentences.en: Read the foundations
sentences.zh: 阅读基础规则

sentences.en: Component page
sentences.zh: 组件页面

sentences.en: One page per component
sentences.zh: 每个组件一页

sentences.en: Specimen
sentences.zh: 示例

sentences.en: The action vocabulary: six intents, three sizes and one focus ring.
sentences.zh: 动作词汇表：六种意图、三档尺寸、一个焦点环。

sentences.en: Tone, dot and size for status that never leans on colour alone.
sentences.zh: 用色调、圆点与尺寸表达状态，从不只依赖颜色。

sentences.en: A surface with intent: canvas, outline, raised or sunken.
sentences.zh: 有意图的表面：画布、描边、抬升、下沉。

sentences.en: What this system believes
sentences.zh: 这套系统相信什么

sentences.en: Four rules decide every component in the library — and every page that documents it.
sentences.zh: 四条规则决定了库里的每个组件，也决定了记录它们的每个页面。

sentences.en: Tokens come before components
sentences.zh: 先有令牌，再有组件

sentences.en: Three layers — core, semantic and utility — so a component never names a colour or a size directly.
sentences.zh: 核心、语义、工具三层令牌，组件从不直接写死颜色或尺寸。

sentences.en: Dark mode is the reference
sentences.zh: 深色模式是参考

sentences.en: The dark theme is designed first; the light theme is an independent design, never an inversion.
sentences.zh: 深色主题先被设计；浅色主题是独立的设计，而不是把深色反过来。

sentences.en: The interface never computes
sentences.zh: 界面从不计算

sentences.en: Charts and tables render values the caller prepared; indicators, factors and backtests stay in the data layer.
sentences.zh: 图表与表格只渲染调用方准备好的数值；指标、因子与回测留在数据层。

sentences.en: Documentation stays honest
sentences.zh: 文档保持诚实

sentences.en: Where a component cannot express something, its page says so instead of quietly faking the result.
sentences.zh: 组件表达不了的地方，页面会直说，而不是悄悄伪造一个结果。

sentences.en: How to read a component page
sentences.zh: 如何阅读组件页面

sentences.en: Each page opens with what the component is for, then a live example, the real import path, the API from the generated catalog and what it does not do.
sentences.zh: 每个页面先讲清组件的用途，接着是可运行的示例、真实的导入路径、来自生成目录的 API，以及它做不到的事。

sentences.en: Where to go next
sentences.zh: 接下来去哪里

sentences.en: Seven surfaces, each with a job: learn the rules, find a component, read a chart, or see a whole product built from the library.
sentences.zh: 七个入口，各有其职：学习规则、查找组件、读懂图表，或者看一个完全由这套库搭出来的产品。

sentences.en: The token layers, colour, type, spacing and elevation rules behind every component.
sentences.zh: 每个组件背后的令牌层级、颜色、字体、间距与高度规则。

sentences.en: Every public primitive and composite, one honest page at a time.
sentences.zh: 每个公开的基础组件与组合组件，一页只讲清一个。

sentences.en: The chart catalogue, and the contracts that keep chart engines out of your data layer.
sentences.zh: 图表目录，以及把图表引擎挡在数据层之外的契约。

sentences.en: Spatial and expressive motion primitives, with reduced-motion behaviour built in.
sentences.zh: 空间与表现力动效原语，内建 reduced-motion 行为。

sentences.en: Sixteen reference products assembled only from public components.
sentences.zh: 十六个只用公开组件搭起来的参考产品。

sentences.en: Data table
sentences.zh: 数据表格

sentences.en: Sorting, filtering, selection and virtualisation for datasets that are actually large.
sentences.zh: 面向真正大型数据集的排序、过滤、选择与虚拟滚动。

sentences.en: Third-party surfaces wrapped behind a LUC contract, starting with TradingView.
sentences.zh: 用 LUC 契约包裹第三方界面，从 TradingView 开始。
